name: wells-nelson-components
description: Shared components for Wells Nelson projects (npm workspaces under src/npm).

scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run check:compat
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release
scripts.pack:all: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('packs',{recursive:true})" && npm pack -w src/npm/displays -w src/npm/interactions -w src/npm/data-storage -w src/npm/build-tools --pack-destination packs
